capabilities: Sync the vault two-way with a chosen Nextcloud folder over WebDAV
Keep both versions as a conflict copy when a file changes on both sides
Apply renames and moves as WebDAV MOVE without retransferring files
Guard against mass deletion with confirmation prompts and deletion limits
Optionally sync hidden files and the Obsidian configuration folder
extras: The plugin interface is currently only in Brazilian Portuguese; the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Free, no telemetry, contacts only the configured Nextcloud server.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault with a self-hosted Nextcloud folder over WebDAV.

relations.evidence: It uses the Nextcloud WebDAV endpoint (/remote.php/dav/files/…)

summary: Two-way vault sync with a Nextcloud folder over WebDAV, with conflict copies, rename handling and deletion safeguards.
